feature1.name: feature_intro
feature1.label: Overview
feature1.title: What This Elf Name Generator Is Good At
feature1.description: Built for tabletop campaigns, novels, and worldbuilding. Every name is invented fresh for your setting instead of recycled from a list.

items.title: Original names, every time
items.description: Each of the ten candidates is invented for your heritage, style, and context. No recycled lists, no slight edits of famous names from fantasy franchises.

items.title: Pronunciation and meaning
items.description: Every name ships with a pronunciation guide and a creative meaning, so you can say it out loud and know what it suggests before you commit.

items.title: Context-aware reasons
items.description: Describe your character's role and the generator explains why each name suits them — a ranger reads differently from a court archivist.

how_to_use.name: how_to_use
how_to_use.label: HOW TO USE
how_to_use.title: How to Use the Elf Name Generator in 3 Steps
how_to_use.description: From blank page to ten usable elf names in under a minute.

items.title: Pick a heritage and style
items.description: Choose one of four ready-made elf cultures or describe your own, then set the sound of the names from graceful to fierce.

items.title: Add character context
items.description: Tell the generator what the names are for — one character, a family clan, or a set of NPCs — and add a role for sharper fits.

items.title: Copy, favorite, or go deeper
items.description: Copy any name, keep favorites for the session, or hit 'More like this' to explore variations around a name you love.

feature2.name: feature_benefits
feature2.label: Benefits
feature2.title: Why a Good Elf Name Matters
feature2.description: Names carry culture. The right one makes an elf feel like they grew up somewhere.

items.title: Heritage shapes the sound
items.description: A moonlit court elf and an ancient woodland elf should not sound alike. The heritage control changes syllables, rhythm, and atmosphere.

items.title: Meanings you can build on
items.description: Each meaning is a creative interpretation — a starting hook for lore you can grow into backstory, plot, and dialogue.

items.title: Consistent naming for groups
items.description: Clan mode keeps a family of names related in shape, while NPC mode keeps a crowd distinct so players never mix them up.

feature3.name: use_cases
feature3.label: Use Cases
feature3.title: Who Uses the Elf Name Generator
feature3.description: Writers and game masters who need elf names that hold up in front of an audience.

items.title: TTRPG players and DMs
items.description: Name a player character instantly, or stock an entire elven settlement with distinct NPCs before the session starts.

items.title: Fantasy novelists
items.description: Keep a consistent naming culture across chapters, with pronunciations you can actually read aloud at events.

items.title: Worldbuilders and game designers
items.description: Draft naming conventions for original elf cultures without borrowing from settings you don't own.

items.title: Are the elf names original?
items.description: Yes. Every name is invented on the spot for your heritage, style, and context. The generator does not copy or slightly modify names from any recognizable fantasy franchise, author, or constructed language.

items.title: What do the meanings mean?
items.description: Meanings are creative interpretations invented for your world, not verified translations of any official language. Treat them as lore hooks you can keep, edit, or expand.

items.title: Can I use the names for RPG characters?
items.description: Yes. The names are built for tabletop characters, player characters, NPCs, and player-facing campaigns. Copy any name straight into your character sheet, or favorite several and compare them.

items.title: How do heritage and style change the results?
items.description: Heritage sets the culture the names come from — a moonlit court, an ancient woodland, a shadow lineage, a scholarly society, or a culture you describe yourself. Style controls the sound, from graceful and melodic to fierce and sharp.

items.title: Why does every name include pronunciation?
items.description: A name you can't say out loud gets avoided at the table. Each candidate includes a simple syllable guide so players and readers can pronounce it confidently.

items.title: How do clan and NPC modes work?
items.description: Clan mode generates ten names that read as one related lineage, useful for families and houses. NPC mode generates ten clearly distinct names, useful for populating a settlement where every name should stand apart.

items.title: Why doesn't it copy names from famous fantasy settings?
items.description: Using names from published franchises raises legal questions and makes your world feel borrowed. Original names keep your setting yours — and 'More like this' explores the sound you love without imitating anyone.
